verdict.rationale: Orrick's own Global Employment & Equity Compensation Solutions page describes a 70+ lawyer, fixed-fee, one-stop shop for global equity and HR legal issues across jurisdictions. That supports the core claim that the firm designs employee equity programs internationally. However, the evidence never names option-plan design or any specific local scheme. Missing for 10: explicit first-party descriptions of option plan/ESOP design work, named coverage of UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP, and Indian ESOP schemes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
